gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-copti: Spaghetti-thin loops, loud as ever. Funnel Display draws every stroke at one width, and Noto Sans Coptic sits beneath it with open, uncrowded mouths that let the line breathe.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-cunei: Funnel Display lays down flat, unswelling curves, like noodles shaped into capitals and lowercase alike. Noto Sans Cuneiform puffs out into round, glassy beads.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-deser: Noto Sans Deseret looks wide and low-slung, with open apertures that never squint. Funnel Display then traces its letters as if with a single marker, and the two play off each other's width.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-devan: Round bowls whose walls never swell or thin make Funnel Display instantly recognizable. And Noto Sans Devanagari tucks in below as a compact sans-serif, its capitals melting into the lowercase.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-duplo: Playful and loud. Funnel Display keeps an unmodulated outline throughout, while Noto Sans Duployan opens its wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, so a heading set large feels generous above it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-elbas: Funnel Display builds its capitals from lines of one constant thickness, giving headings a marker-bold presence. And Noto Sans Elbasan follows in large lowercase forms with terminals that never pinch shut.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-elyma: Noto Sans Elymaic keeps its apertures open and its ascenders barely above the x-height. Funnel Display, with a line like spaghetti laid out in letters, gives the pair its most memorable quality: a loud head over a tidy body.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-ethio: A single fixed nib width gives Funnel Display its look, spaghetti-like and sure of itself. Noto Sans Ethiopic carries a longer page on a tall, sturdy lowercase, with c terminals hanging well clear of the bowl.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-georg: Funnel Display swaps thin hairline joins for full-width stroke connections, and the effect is bold and noodle-like. It earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-glago: Noto Sans Glagolitic keeps its round letters open and its lowercase tall and sturdy, so small sizes stay clear. But Funnel Display is the one for loud, marker-like lines with a steady weight.
